examples.text: Пусть сам смотрит нашу столицу.
examples.trans: Let him tour our capital on his own.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'прятать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to hide', paired with 'прятать'.

examples.text: Прости, это я сама его спрятала.
examples.trans: Forgive me, I hid it myself.

examples.text: Мэр спрятал деньги.
examples.trans: The mayor hid the money.

examples.text: Где ты это спрятал?
examples.trans: Where did you hide it?

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'thought', paired with 'подумать'.

examples.text: Ты правда так спокойно думаешь?
examples.trans: Do you really think so calmly?

examples.text: Не думай про маму, она сильная.
examples.trans: Do not worry about mom, she is strong.

examples.text: Как всегда, мы думали только о себе.
examples.trans: As always, we thought only about ourselves.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'so', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Ты правда так спокойно думаешь?
examples.trans: Do you really think so calmly?

examples.text: Костя, нельзя же так с отцом!
examples.trans: Kostya, you cannot treat your father like that!

examples.text: Я слышал, они так часто делают.
examples.trans: I heard they often do it that way.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'faster', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Пойдём быстрее на свежий воздух.
examples.trans: Let us go quickly to the fresh air.

examples.text: Быстро в номер и всё оттуда убрали!
examples.trans: Quickly to the room and clear everything out of there!

examples.text: Некогда объяснять, бегите быстрее!
examples.trans: No time to explain, run faster!

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'ружиться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to make friends'.

related.gloss: not to to make friends (negated infinitive)

examples.text: Подружись с её ребёнком.
examples.trans: Make friends with her child.

examples.text: Хочешь понравиться женщине? Подружись с её ребёнком.
examples.trans: Want a woman to like you? Make friends with her child.

examples.text: Все нормально, вы подружитесь.
examples.trans: It is fine. You will get along.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian clause-linking conjunction meaning 'so that, in order to', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Или тебя здесь что-то держит?
examples.trans: Or is something keeping you here?

examples.text: Что это за внеплановый семейный совет?
examples.trans: What is this unscheduled family council?

examples.text: Хорошо, что паспорт лежал в другом кармане.
examples.trans: It is a good thing my passport was in another pocket.

meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'ехать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'left, went away', paired with 'уезжать'.

examples.text: Я хочу, чтобы он сейчас уехал!
examples.trans: I want him to leave right now!

examples.text: Я уеду на час.
examples.trans: I'll be gone for an hour.

examples.text: Он уехал в Москву.
examples.trans: He has gone to Moscow.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'how', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: А как же мы с мамой?
examples.trans: And what about your mother and me?

examples.text: Прочитай, может, это шпион какой-то?
examples.trans: Read it, maybe he is some kind of spy?

examples.text: Какой же будем ставить диагноз?
examples.trans: What diagnosis are we going to give?
